blocks.title: Incredibly Light.
blocks.text: Weighing in at under 2 pounds, it redefines portability without compromising an ounce of performance.

blocks.title: Devastatingly Powerful.
blocks.text: Powered by our next-generation neural engine, capable of 15 trillion operations per second.

blocks.title: Silently Brilliant.
blocks.text: A revolutionary fanless thermal design keeps things running completely silent, even under heavy load.
